entries.name: Initiative
entries.text: Roll to see who goes first in each of the following phases.

entries.name: Wizard Phase
entries.text: Each player activates their wizard plus up to 3 soldiers within 3".

entries.name: Apprentice Phase
entries.text: Each player activates their apprentice plus up to 3 soldiers within 3".

entries.name: Soldier Phase
entries.text: Each player activates all their soldiers that have not previously activated.

entries.name: Creature Phase
entries.text: All non-controlled creatures activate.

entries.name: Actions per activation
entries.text: All figures normally have 2 actions.

entries.name: Move
entries.text: Must use one action.

entries.name: 2nd Move
entries.text: A figure may take a second move action in the same activation, at half distance.

entries.name: Fight
entries.text: Attack a figure it is In Combat with.

entries.name: Shoot
entries.text: Make a ranged attack against a valid target.

entries.name: Cast a spell
entries.text: Attempt to cast a known spell.

entries.name: Special
entries.text: Any other action specific to an item, spell, or trait.

entries.name: Group Activation
entries.text: All figures in a group activation must move as their first action.

entries.name: Climbing or Rough Ground
entries.text: Costs 2" of movement for every 1" (or partial 1") actually moved.

entries.name: Jumping
entries.text: A figure can jump up to 4" horizontally, but must have moved the same distance in a straight line first.

entries.name: Combat
entries.text: A figure In Combat may not move.

entries.name: Forcing Combat
entries.text: A figure not In Combat may intercept an enemy figure that moves within 1" of it.

entries.name: Falling
entries.text: Less than 3": no effect. Greater than 3": take damage equal to 1.5x the distance fallen in inches.

entries.name: Swimming
entries.text: Modified by circumstances. Success: activates as normal. Failure: no actions this turn, and takes damage equal to the amount by which the roll failed.

entries.name: Run For It
entries.text: For its first action, a figure may move 3" regardless of any movement penalties. Its activation immediately ends afterward.

entries.name: Resolving a Combat Roll
entries.text: Both figures roll a die and add their Fight stat plus any other relevant modifiers (e.g. bonuses from magic or supporting figures). Highest Combat Roll wins. Add the winner's damage modifiers (e.g. +2 for a two-handed weapon, -1 for a dagger), then subtract the loser's Armour, then apply any damage multipliers. If the final total is above 0, subtract that many points from the loser's Health; 0 or negative means no damage. The winner may then remain in combat, or push either figure back 1".

entries.name: Dagger
entries.text: The first dagger a figure carries does not take up an item slot.

entries.name: Two-Handed Weapon
entries.text: Takes up two item slots.

entries.name: Staff
entries.text: Applies -1 to both the wielder's and the opponent's damage modifier in hand-to-hand combat.

entries.name: Bow
entries.text: Load and fire as a single action; must have a quiver.

entries.name: Crossbow
entries.text: Load and fire as separate actions; may reload in place of movement; must have a quiver.

entries.name: Shield
entries.text: May not be carried with a two-handed weapon or staff.

entries.name: Supporting Figure
entries.text: Every friendly figure also in combat with the target and not in combat with another figure grants +2, cumulative (three eligible figures grant +6). Only one figure per combat may benefit from supporting figures: if both sides are eligible for the same bonus they cancel out and both fight at +0; if one is eligible for more than the other, the higher only counts the difference. A figure may never claim more than +6 from supporting figures.

entries.name: Resolving a shooting attack
entries.text: The shooter checks range and line of sight, then declares a target and makes a Shooting Roll (die + Shoot stat). The target makes a Combat Roll (die + Fight stat + shooting defence modifiers). Highest wins; ties or a target win mean the attack misses. If the shooter wins, add damage modifiers (e.g. +2 for a crossbow) to the Shooting Roll, subtract the target's Armour, apply any damage multipliers, and if the total is above 0 the target loses that much Health.

entries.name: Intervening Terrain
entries.text: Per piece of intervening terrain between shooter and target. A target in base contact with terrain counts as cover instead; terrain the shooter is in base contact with doesn't count (though it may still block line of sight). Other figures do count as intervening terrain.

entries.name: Light Cover
entries.text: The target is in contact with solid cover obscuring up to half its body, or soft cover almost completely obscuring it.

entries.name: Heavy Cover
entries.text: The target is in contact with solid cover that almost completely obscures its body.

entries.name: Hasty Shot
entries.text: The shooter moved earlier in this activation.

entries.name: Large Target
entries.text: The target is particularly tall or broad — normally only creatures with the Large trait.

entries.name: Casting Roll
entries.text: Roll a die (-2 if the caster is an Apprentice). The result must equal or exceed the spell's Casting Number.

entries.name: Empowering
entries.text: Increase the Casting Roll by 1 for every 1 Health spent.

entries.name: Failed by 1-4
entries.text: No damage.

entries.name: Failed by 5-9
entries.text: 1 damage to the caster.

entries.name: Failed by 10-19
entries.text: 2 damage to the caster.

entries.name: Failed by 20+
entries.text: 5 damage to the caster.

entries.name: Picking up treasure
entries.text: Cannot be done if an enemy figure is within 1".

entries.name: Carrying limit
entries.text: A figure may only carry one treasure token.

entries.name: Move penalty
entries.text: A figure carrying treasure has its Move halved.

entries.name: Encumbrance
entries.text: A figure carrying treasure while armed with a shield, two-handed weapon, staff, bow, or crossbow is encumbered: -1 Fight, in addition to its Move being halved.

entries.name: General rule
entries.text: Creatures will never attack another creature, and will always force combat if possible.

entries.name: 1. Is it In Combat?
entries.text: It fights. If it wins, it stays in combat. If in combat with more than one opponent, it attacks whichever has the lowest current Health. Otherwise, proceed to step 2.

entries.name: 2. Is a warband member in line of sight?
entries.text: If armed with a missile weapon and a warband member is in range, it shoots the closest eligible target (no second action taken). Otherwise it moves as far as possible toward the closest visible warband member, climbing obstacles as needed, moving into combat if possible; if it moved into combat and has an action left, go back to step 1. Otherwise proceed to step 3.

entries.name: 3. Random movement
entries.text: The creature moves its full Move in a random direction, halting at any wall or obstacle. If it still has an action left afterward, re-check step 2 — if still no target, its activation ends with no second action; otherwise proceed with step 2 as normal.
